shots.action: 真实侧面跟拍；白绮坐在清楚可见的黑色车座上，座管连续连接车座与车架，臀部保持合理承重。双脚各踩原有对置踏板，左右腿从第一帧持续自然交替踩踏，曲柄保持180度相对。车座、座管与车架不消失或变形；林木和路面连续后移，没有背景跳变。
shots.prompt: Use <Picture 1> as the exact first frame of a single uninterrupted five-second realistic bicycle travel shot. The one woman is already SEATED on the existing black padded saddle, supported by its exposed metal rails, clamp and seatpost continuously joined to the original seat tube. The black saddle rear edge and forward nose and the visible seatpost remain recognizable throughout; her hips stay seated at the same sensible height, with only small natural pedaling movement. Preserve the two original wheels, frame tubes, fork, hubs, chainring, chain, cranks and pedals as a mechanically connected bicycle of fixed shape. The two crank arms stay exactly opposed at 180 degrees about the same bottom-bracket axle. Each of her two boots stays on its own flat pedal, the midsole resting over the spindle; her knees bend and extend in regular alternation through approximately three calm crank revolutions over five seconds, starting immediately. No foot detaches, passes through a frame tube or follows a separate imaginary crank center. The camera tracks smoothly at the bicycle's forward speed from the same drive-side position; the whole saddle/seatpost stays inside the same frame. The same road, leaf litter and tree trunks slide backward with continuous depth and parallax, with natural rotating wheels, never resetting or cutting. Same feminine white/deep-violet/gold pleated dress, opaque white legwear and purple butterfly-trim ankle boots. Her entire head, face, chin, neck and chest remain above the image boundary; no other person or human reflection. Her hands remain outside the original crop, do not add detached arms or hands. Keep the existing Vivhite sticker as fixed inert print on its original frame tube, with identical OPEN violet-pink star irises, thin complete round gold glasses, face proportions and costume; no blink, facial redraw or autonomous expression. No disappearing/floating saddle, shifting seatpost, changing bicycle geometry, extra limb, extra bike, frozen pedaling, reverse pedaling, initial still hold, scene transition, added vegetation, subtitles, lettering, credits, speech, singing, humming or other voices. Ordinary tire and chain ambience only.
